summary: Murder and destruction of evidence under IPC s.302 and s.201; circumstantial evidence case; extra-judicial confession before Village Police Patil; admissibility under Evidence Act s.25; Village Police Patil deemed police officer; confession inadmissible; discovery of iron rod under s.27 Evidence Act scrutinized; motive, last seen, and special knowledge considered; burden under s.106 invoked by High Court; reversal of acquittal challenged; standard of proof beyond reasonable doubt; reappreciation of evidence in appeal
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; acquittal restored.
